preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(row, list) and all(isinstance(cell, int) and cell in {0, 1} for cell in row) for row in grid)
preconditions.description: The input grid is a non-empty 2D list where each cell is either 0 (sea) or 1 (land).
The grid has at least one row and one column.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for i in range(len(grid)) for j in range(len(grid[i])) if grid[i][j] == 1 and not any(is_boundary_reachable(grid, i, j, set())))
postconditions.description: The return value is the count of land cells (1s) that cannot reach any boundary cell (edge of the grid) via adjacent land cells (4-directional moves).
